answer_1.quote: We introduce VGen, a benchmark evaluating LLMs' vector-graphics generation capability. We use text to vector-graphics (T2VG) generation to test an LLM's ability to generate vector graphics code conditioned on a text prompt.
answer_1.outputs: Vector graphics code in SVG, TikZ, or Graphviz format

answer_2.quote: For text-to-vector-graphic generation (T2VG), we utilize GPT-4V to generate the captions and then use CLIP Score and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) to evaluate the quality of the LLM generated vector graphics code.
